title: Classify changes as minor or major and require an audit around major changes
description: CERT-In CCSAPG 13.1.2 requires formal change management that classifies changes as minor or major, with a cyber security audit before a major change is implemented and after it goes live. Examples of major changes: system overhauls, technology migrations, and configuration changes affecting sensitive data or critical infrastructure such as mcp-gateway prod or the MongoDB client-data store. Update the company change-management policy in the ISMS repository to define the classification criteria, the pre-implementation audit gate and the post-change audit trigger, and link the gate to the Task 2 calendar. sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess has no field for change classification (schema v1/company/sdlc-policy.schema.json). Do not add a key there. Ask soc-ledger-keeper to record the gap as a manual observation against cert-in-directions-2022:CCSAPG-13.1.2.
acceptanceCriteria: The approved change-management policy version defines minor and major changes with at least three concrete examples of major changes that name mcp-gateway or the client-data store.
The policy states that a major change cannot move to production without a completed pre-implementation cyber security audit reference, and that a post-change audit is scheduled in the audit calendar.

A manual observation in company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl against cert-in-directions-2022:CCSAPG-13.1.2 records that sdlc/policy.json has no change-classification field and cites the policy document locator.

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer opens the approved policy version and the ledger observation. Expected result: the classification criteria, the pre-implementation audit gate and the post-change audit trigger are present, and the observation exists with methods [manual] and a document locator.

rootCause.description: The release process in sdlc/policy.json covers approvals and rollback but not minor/major classification, so nothing triggers the audit that CERT-In CCSAPG 13.1.2 requires around major changes.
